full_theorem_gate.missing: No single located public dataset holds one physical cue matrix fixed while changing the focal action map so that realized early outcomes select among different costly later cues, with fixed-versus-contingent access under a common finite budget.

derived_signature.post_acquisition_accuracy: approximately 0.93-0.94 across all three difficulty levels
derived_signature.interpretation: Bees increasingly pay for information as unaided accuracy collapses, and acquisition restores high accuracy.

yuan_2026.claim_ceiling: Directly validates costly, state-dependent active information acquisition and performance recovery, but not branch-specific choice among different next cues or C_A<C_F in the deterministic theorem.

independent_reaggregation.method: Fetched the public CSV in four non-overlapping line ranges from source commit 7f886394b4de872ecdb19ca4ea214ec321d5dce9 and recomputed counts directly from all 19,200 rows; no published summary or repository-derived aggregate was used.
independent_reaggregation.interpretation: Raw trial counts independently confirm a monotonic rise in costly information acquisition as unaided discrimination collapses, while post-acquisition accuracy remains approximately 0.93 across difficulty.

access_mode_interpretation.regular: The predictive cue is obtained only if the bee lands on the Zone-1 information-request platform; a correct post-request choice is paid at a discounted reward, so acquisition is voluntary and costly.
access_mode_interpretation.random_free_cue: The predictive cue is presented automatically upon entering the front half of Zone 1, independent of platform landing. Platform landing therefore becomes separable from cue receipt.
access_mode_interpretation.relevance_to_routeability: This is a causal manipulation of the necessity/cost of information acquisition and is substantially closer to contingent-versus-unconditional access than a simple cue-preference study, but it still offers only one optional information source rather than branch-specific alternative next cues.

maboudi_2025.claim_ceiling: Supports active sequential sampling and a topology-preserving reciprocal reward-label negative control; not a positive same-environment action-topology manipulation.

spaethe_2026.claim_ceiling: Shows bees allocate/learn secondary visual attributes when the primary colour cue is hard, but cues are simultaneously available and physical colour discriminability changes.

smolla_2016.claim_ceiling: Supports uncertainty-dependent information-source use, not explicit alternative next-cue acquisition.

near_topology_examples_without_reusable_.signature: flower type determines whether flower size predicts reward
earlier priming cue determines which later target is correct
illumination context reverses the correct target colour

prospective_history_check.result: Previous-trial correctness adds little predictive signal for the next Regular-trial request after stratifying by current difficulty.
prospective_history_check.decision: Do not use one-step reward history as evidence for routeability; the supported conditioning variable is current evidence quality/difficulty.

empirical_program.theory_paper_use: One compact empirical-convergence/biological-grounding panel or subsection, explicitly labelled componentwise rather than full theorem validation.
empirical_program.strongest_public_bridge: Yuan 2026 raw public trials for costly contingent information acquisition; Spaethe 2026 for secondary-cue recruitment; MaBouDi 2025 for selective sequential sensing.
empirical_program.remaining_direct_experiment: Hold the physical cue matrix fixed, alter the focal action mapping so different early outcomes make different later cues relevant, allow costly cue acquisition under a finite budget, and test the predicted architecture-by-access interaction.
